arriveLines: You arrive in Emberhaven. WASD or arrows to walk, Ctrl to run, or click the ground.
Open Inventory (F1) for food. Bury bones, Trade with Mira, Fish/Chop/Mine, or Bank at Elise.
The Guildmaster by the courtyard has work.
respawnLine: You wake in Emberhaven, barely standing.
deathLog: You died. Your items lie in a gravestone — respawn in Emberhaven, then click it to reclaim them. Return to title abandons the run.

tutorials.walk: Tutorial: You took your first steps.
tutorials.talk: Tutorial: You spoke with a townsfolk.
tutorials.fight: Tutorial: You won your first fight.
tutorials.bury: Tutorial: You buried bones for Prayer.

questCompleteFallback: Militia task complete. Explore the nine lands.
questStartFallback: Talk to Guildmaster Bram in Emberhaven.
